summary: The parity-energy estimate correctly forces the total mass of atoms below e/64 to be strictly less than 1/4. The marginal halfspace hypothesis gives depth at least 1/4 and places z0 in the convex hull of the positive-mass support, so accepted fact a02e76f89b3b8062 applies with all hypotheses satisfied and yields a point in the z0-fiber of mixed halfspace depth at least W/64. The identification of the fiber-sum measure with the mixed-integer measure and the maximizer consequence are correct.
